start.advice:
This game lives from its mood.
It is at its best with headphones, or somewhere quiet.
notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.unknown: something I do not know yet
pause.title: Pause
pause.confirm:
Start over from the beginning?
Everything you have done so far will be lost.
note.village.title: The village
note.village.text: A piece of land hanging in the void. I know its paths before I walk them.
note.stone_at_bridge.title: The stone by the bridge
note.stone_at_bridge.text: It lay beside the tree, not on the path. Once it was back there, the brook ran the right way again.
note.old_man.title: The old man
note.old_man.text: He knows the way I walk, but not my name. The notebook lay on his table before the Rift. It is written in my handwriting.
note.evening_walks.title: Across the bridge at dusk
note.evening_walks.text: A woman by the brook used to see me cross it every evening. Where I went, I no longer know.
old_man.first: ... You. I know the way you walk.
The lanterns are burning again. Was that you?
So much has been wrong here since the Rift. The wind. The trees. I just cannot recall how it used to be.
There is a notebook on the table over there. It lay there before everything tore apart. It is not mine. Take it.
old_man.hint_wind: The wind stands wrong. It always came from the mill hill.
The stone arch at the eastern edge used to lead there. Perhaps it does again.
old_man.whole: Now I can hear it again. The village sounds the way it did.
I remember your name. Give me a moment and I will find it.
stranger.remembers: You used to cross this bridge every evening.
I never asked where you were going.
stranger.lanterns: You came across the bridge. Nobody has done that in a long time.
Do you see the lanterns? Not one has burned since the Rift. We tried everything. For us they stay dark.
The old man in the house up the path might know what to do. But since the Rift his door leads everywhere except inside.
stranger.lanterns_lit: Things listen to you again. Try the old man's door. Perhaps it will find its way back as well.
And look, the stone arch at the edge is shimmering again. The mill hill used to lie beyond it.
old_man.take_it: The notebook. On the table over there. Go on, take it.
notebook.taken: A small notebook. The first pages are already written on.
arch.closed: An arch of old stones. Beyond it there is only sky.
old_man.crank: The miller's crank? I had forgotten all about it.
Look in the cupboard. Take it with you.
old_man.hint_brook: The wind is blowing the right way again. Can you hear it?
But the brook still runs uphill. Its spring lies beyond the mill.
cupboard.crank: Between old blankets lies a heavy iron crank.
miller.crank: She has stood still since the Rift. Not a sail moves, and the wind is gone.
The crank is missing. I lent it to the old man in the village, long before. It should be in his cupboard.
I cannot get away from here. The arches only ever lead me in circles.
miller.have_crank: That is it! Set it on the mill, right beside the door.
miller.turning: Do you hear that? She is grinding again.
The wind reaches all the way down to the village now. And at the spring it drives things back to where they belong.
mill.stuck: The sails stand still. Where the crank should sit there is only an empty hole.
mill.turns: The crank catches. A creak, then the sails begin to turn.
raft.away: A raft used to cross the brook here. Now it lies over in the pond, on the far bank.
The wind must have driven it across.
sluice.opens: The sluice gives way. The water runs off, down the brook.
note.mill_hill.title: The mill hill
note.mill_hill.text: A hill with a windmill. The wind always came to the village from here.
note.spring.title: The spring
note.spring.text: A pond where the brook rises. A sluice holds the water back.
note.arch_village.title: The arch in the village
note.arch_village.text: The stone arch at the eastern edge of the village leads to the mill hill. It only opens once the lanterns burn.
note.arch_mill.title: The arches on the mill hill
note.arch_mill.text: The left arch leads back to the village, the right one to the spring.
note.arch_spring.title: The arch at the spring
note.arch_spring.text: It did not take me back to the mill hill but to the village. The ways are wrongly joined as long as the sluice is closed.
note.crank.title: The crank of the mill
note.crank.text: Without its crank the mill stands still. The miller lent it to the old man. It should be in his cupboard.
note.raft.title: The raft
note.raft.text: The raft at the spring lies on the wrong bank. The wind drove it there. The wind comes from the mill.
